title: locationSuggestion.searchFilter
description:
The Search API filter for this suggestion. Pass its property as a URL parameter to `GET /events`, `GET /places` or `GET /offers`, as it is, to find the results at or around the suggested location.

The suggestion contains exactly one of these properties:

- `coordinates`: for a point, like a street or an address. Add your own `distance` parameter, for example `?coordinates=50.88943,4.72002&distance=5km`.
- `regions`: for an area, like a municipality. Pass every value as a `regions[]` parameter, for example `?regions[]=nis-24062`. You can combine it with your own `distance` parameter to also find results within that distance of the area.

oneOf.title: Point
oneOf.description: For a street or an address.

coordinates.description: The latitude and longitude of a point, separated by a comma, in the format of the `coordinates` URL parameter.

oneOf.title: Area
oneOf.description: For a municipality or a part of one.

regions.description: The ids of the regions of an area, in the format of the `regions[]` URL parameter.
